title: Simulation and fault injection: SITL, MAVLink and NAVERA's simulator
summary: Close the loop: your NAVERA Lite flies a simulated vehicle whose autopilot only knows the MAVLink bytes you send it. Decode GPS_INPUT byte by byte, check the simulator's sensor models (Gauss–Markov noise, Rayleigh errors), derive expected values from the rules, run a fault-injection campaign (jam, silence, jump, drift, blackout, late camera, IMU) as a test engineer, diagnose the run that fails — then fly your own judge, guard, Kalman filter and trained networks in the loop.
